9.title: Regulation Crypto, CLARITY & the Market-Structure Fight
9.summary: The regulatory story is getting more specific. The Senate CLARITY Act vote remains pushed into September, but expectations are building around an SEC vote on August 14 involving a proposed Regulation Crypto framework. Reporting in this morning's file describes a potential path for certain issuers to raise up to seventy-five million dollars outside traditional registration while still providing audited financials and semiannual reporting. Fidelity is also seeking SEC approval to add staking to its Ethereum ETF. The central question for this hour is whether the next phase of U.S. crypto adoption depends
